Shilajit is `a sticky, tar-like exudate harvested from mountain crevices (primarily in the Himalayas)` . Formed by the centuries-long decomposition of plant matter, it is a key compound in Ayurvedic medicine. It is used as a supplement to potentially boost energy, support testosterone levels, and provide antioxidant benefits.[](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3296184/) [[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3296184/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shilajit)[[3]](https://www.sciencedirect.com/topics/pharmacology-toxicology-and-pharmaceutical-science/shilajeet)[[4]](https://www.amazon.com/Shilajit-Plus-Capsules-Ashwagandha-Performance/dp/B0DQCJ48C8)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L5WMpCJEJgc)

How it Works

Shilajit is composed of up to 80% humic substances and is highly concentrated in **fulvic acid** , which enhances the body's ability to absorb and utilize minerals. It also contains over 80 trace minerals, including iron, calcium, zinc, and magnesium.[](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12703986/) [[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12703986/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L5WMpCJEJgc)[[3]](https://www.news-medical.net/health/Shilajit-Health-Benefits-Risks-and-Clinical-Evidence.aspx)

Potential Health Benefits

- **Energy and Stamina:** Traditionally used to combat fatigue and improve physical performance.
- **Cognitive Health:** Early studies suggest fulvic acid may help prevent cognitive decline and act as an antioxidant.
- **Fertility and Testosterone:** Some evidence points to shilajit's ability to boost testosterone levels and support sperm count in men.
- **Bone and Skin Health:** Its anti-inflammatory properties may help slow oxidative stress, protect against bone density loss, and support collagen production.[](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3296184/) [[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3296184/)[[2]](https://www.amazon.com/Shilajit-Plus-Capsules-Ashwagandha-Performance/dp/B0DQCJ48C8)[[3]](https://megafood.com/products/shilajit)[[4]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/shilajit-benefits)[[5]](https://www.health.com/shilajit-benefits-8349131)

Forms and Dosage Shilajit is sold in several distinct forms:[](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit) [[1]](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit)[[2]](https://www.gnc.com/buy/shilajit-supplements-for-stamina-enhancement)

- **Resin:** The raw, tar-like purified form; usually dissolved in warm water or milk.
- **Capsules or Tablets:** Offer a standardized, convenient dosage.
- **Powder or Gummies:** Easy to mix into smoothies or take as a daily vitamin.  
Dosages typically range between 300 to 500 milligrams per day, but exact recommendations vary by the concentration and the specific product.[](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit) [[1]](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit)[[2]](https://www.gnc.com/buy/shilajit-supplements-for-stamina-enhancement)[[3]](https://megafood.com/products/shilajit)[[4]](https://evergreen.ie/blogs/health-advice/what-is-shilajit)[[5]](https://livefresh.de/en/blogs/news/entdecke-shilajit-mumijo-das-geheimnisvolle-wunder-aus-den-bergen)

Safety and Precautions

- **Purification is Crucial:** Raw, unpurified shilajit can contain contaminants like heavy metals, free radicals, and fungi. Always choose reputable brands that feature third-party testing for purity.[](https://www.amazon.com/Shilajit-Plus-Capsules-Ashwagandha-Performance/dp/B0DQCJ48C8) [[1]](https://www.amazon.com/Shilajit-Plus-Capsules-Ashwagandha-Performance/dp/B0DQCJ48C8)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shilajit)[[3]](https://www.gnc.com/buy/shilajit-supplements-for-stamina-enhancement)[[4]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/shilajit-benefits)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L5WMpCJEJgc)
- **FDA Status:** Shilajit is not reviewed or approved by the FDA for safety or efficacy.[](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit) [[1]](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit)
- **Potential Side Effects:** While generally well tolerated, side effects can include severe allergic reactions, racing heart, dizziness, or rash in sensitive individuals. People with hemochromatosis (too much iron in the blood) should avoid it, as it naturally contains high levels of iron.[](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit) [[1]](https://www.webmd.com/vitamins-supplements/shilajit)[[2]](https://www.health.com/shilajit-benefits-8349131)[[3]](https://www.medkart.in/order-medicine/aimil-shilajit-gold-capsule-20s)[[4]](https://www.netmeds.com/product/kapiva-shilajit-gold-capsule-30s-lui6se-8331282)[[5]](https://www.metropolisindia.com/blog/preventive-healthcare/shilajit-benefits)

Always consult a healthcare provider before introducing a new supplement to your daily routine. For verified third-party tested products, you can explore offerings on supplement platforms like [GNC](https://www.gnc.com/buy/shilajit-supplements-for-stamina-enhancement) or check clinical studies on [PubMed](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3296184/).[[1]](https://www.gnc.com/buy/shilajit-supplements-for-stamina-enhancement)
